source: GoogleTrendArchive: Google Trends 'Trending Now' national feeds for 125 countries, collected every 10 minutes, Nov. 27, 2024 to May 17, 2026. Topics merged by the world-attention pipeline.
note: Topics by the number of countries whose national feed ever had them trending (Nov. 2024 to May 2026). words = a fixed random sample of real searches per pile (the most common phrasing of each topic, with Claude's English name as translation when it differs), plus two named examples per pile. Hidden topics, junk topics and people reaching fewer than 15 countries are left out; each sampled topic trended at least 3 times. Not one word per topic: piles are scaled by share.
takeaway: 84.9% of trending topics never left one country.
